pages.text: Addendum for $(l:offsprings/singer)$(c)$(o)Singer$().$(br)$(br)It's fascinating to see that the true desire of an Enderman is to just get attention - something it can only handle as a Singer, as a simple Enderman can't help but respond with aggression to its own shyness... But what I find even more interesting is the sound-making abilities of a Singer. Endermen are relatively loud to begin with,

but Singers enhance the power behind their voices using their hollow torso as a sort of 'echo chamber'. At one time, even I underestimated just how strong their singing was. Using a Lover, I managed to create a Singer near my research lab and placed it into an observation cell. Everything went swimmingly until I took off the Carved Pumpkin, after which it began singing. The vibrations of its voice broke the glass wall of the cell - including the walls of neighbouring cells that had
their own specimens inside... It was very chaotic.
